title: cycas siamensis subsp. balansae
intro: Cycas siamensis subsp. balansae, commonly known as the Thai Giant Cycad, is a species of cycad in the family Cycadaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects. The therapeutic actions of this plant include reducing fever, relieving pain, and treating respiratory issues, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as saponins, alkaloids, and flavonoids. These bioactive constituents are believed to contribute to the plant's antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory activities, making it a valuable resource for traditional medicine.
